description: This file contains a utility function for extracting and formatting an API key from HTTP request headers, specifically for use with the FastAPI framework. It prioritizes the custom header 'x-litellm-api-key' over the standard 'Authorization' header.

methods.name: str get_litellm_virtual_key(request: Request)
methods.description: Extracts the Litellm virtual key from request headers, returning it formatted for use as a Bearer token. Prefers 'x-litellm-api-key' header if present, otherwise falls back to the 'Authorization' header.
